model_annotation: The diagram compares the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021. The diagram consists of three donut charts, each representing one of the categories, and together they comprise a total of 12 sectors. In the "Number of Enterprises" chart, the four sectors are labeled and colored differently, with "Other Services" being the largest at 61% or 19.0 million, followed by "Trade" at 19% or 5.9 million, "Construction" at 12% or 3.7 million, and "Industry" at 8% or 2.4 million. The "Number of Persons Employed" chart also has four sectors, with "Other Services" being the largest at 51% or 80.2 million, followed by "Trade" at 19% or 29.5 million, "Industry" at 21% or 33.0 million, and "Construction" at 9% or 13.4 million. The "Turnover" chart has the same four sectors, with "Industry" being the largest at 33% or 10.6 trillion, followed by "Other Services" and "Trade" both at 31% or 9.8 and 9.9 trillion respectively, and "Construction" at 6% or 1.9 trillion. A legend is provided below the charts, indicating the color corresponding to each sector, and the percentage and absolute values are labeled within each sector. The sectors appear to be ordered consistently across the three charts, with "Other Services" generally being the largest or among the largest.
